title: Nerve Excitability in Cisplatin-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy
official: Evaluation of Nerve Excitability in Cisplatin-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy
summary: This study aims to evaluate nerve excitability in participants with cisplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy (cis-PN) using threshold tracking nerve conduction studies (TTNCS). By assessing changes in nerve excitability parameters, the study seeks to enhance understanding of the pathophysiology of cis-PN and identify early markers of neurotoxicity in participants undergoing cisplatin-based chemotherapy.
